market_question: Will Houston Texans win the 2027 NFL AFC Championship?
reasoning: The Texans are a solid young team, but the AFC remains stacked with perennial contenders like the Chiefs, Bills, Ravens, and Bengals. The 2027 AFC Championship is two seasons away, introducing high uncertainty. A 10.1% implied probability equates to a ~6.5-7% annual AFC title chance over two years, which is unsustainably high for a non-Chiefs team. A more realistic single-year probability is around 4-5%, giving a roughly 5% chance for that specific game.
evidence_points: Chiefs have appeared in 5 of the last 6 AFC Championships, commanding a large share of probability.
Texans futures odds for the 2025 Super Bowl imply an AFC title chance of about 4-5% (DraftKings data).
The market pricing implies a ~6.5% annual AFC win rate for Houston over the next two seasons, well above the consensus for a team that has never made a conference final.
sources_consulted: DraftKings Super Bowl futures odds (2025 season)
